The main takeaway from our work is that

the circular law holds true under a very general assumption on the law of the entries, which includes the real Ginibre model as well as many other random matrices with independent entries, such as the real and complex Wishart ensembles, random band matrices, random matrices with correlated entries, and random matrices with heavy-tailed entries.
